intro.description: TripMate is a web platform for those who love to travel and discover new places. We strive to combine information about tourist destinations and planning tools in one convenient space. With the help of the website, travelers can explore the sights of Kazakhstan, choose interesting locations, and create routes based on their own preferences.

individualRoutes.description: Routes and stops in one place

adaptability.title: Adaptability
adaptability.description: Use the website on your computer and phone.

1.question: How do I create my own travel route?
1.answer: Go to the Trip Planner page, choose the destinations you want to visit, and arrange them in your preferred order. You can then fill in your travel details and save your route.

2.question: Can I choose multiple destinations?
2.answer: Yes! You can add several tourist attractions to your route. All selected destinations will appear in the My Route section.

3.question: Does TripMate support multiple languages?
3.answer: TripMate is designed to support Kazakh, Russian, and English, making travel planning more convenient for different users.

4.question: Can I see my destinations on a map?
4.answer: Yes. The Route Map section displays your selected destinations on an interactive map of Kazakhstan. You can view markers and the order of your stops.

5.question: How can I save my travel plan?
5.answer: Complete the Journey Form and click Save. Your trip information will be saved in your browser. You can also click Export to download your route as a JSON file.

6.question: Can I use TripMate on my phone?
6.answer: Yes! TripMate has a responsive design that adapts to desktop computers, tablets, and smartphones.
